Privacy

This portfolio presents the work of Omar Nabail. For questions about the content, contact omargamal039@gmail.com.

How this website works

The portfolio uses static pages. Its application code does not include visitor analytics, advertising trackers, a contact form, or browser-storage features.

Hosting

This website is hosted with GitHub Pages. GitHub may process technical request information, including visitor IP addresses, for security purposes. See GitHub’s privacy statement for details.

External links and email

GitHub, LinkedIn, and Hugging Face links take you to external services governed by their own privacy policies. Selecting an email link opens your email application; this website does not submit a message on your behalf.
